messages:
maya (Finance): heads up — I see a ~$8.1k charge on the dedicated-reserved invoice for ap-east (INV-2026-04-01) and promo credits didn’t apply. anyone else seeing this?

alex (Infra): hmm we deprovisioned a few ap-east reserved clusters yesterday afternoon. did the deprovision trigger a fallback to payg or change the account tag?

nina (Billing): pulling ledger now. quick summary: the promo credits (promo-APR2026) were in the org-level promo pool, but last week we created a reserved-commit subaccount/tag that excludes org promos by default. looks like the dedicated usage was attributed to reserved-commit and therefore 0 credits matched. snippet from the invoice export:

```
INVOICE INV-2026-04-01
Line: DEDICATED-POOL ap-east | usage 2026-03-31 | 123 GPUs | $8,102.00 | Credits applied: $0.00
```

billing-bot: NOTICE: promo-APR2026 expired 2026-04-02 00:00:00 UTC. Remaining balance at expiry: $12,450.00.

jun (Finance Ops): if the invoice already closed we’ll need a retro credit allocation + adjustment (journal + credit memo). can finance ops retroapply from the promo pool to the reserved-commit account? what’s the process with our cloud partner for a retro credit?

alex (Infra): from infra side: two asks — 1) prevent deprovision/fallback from flipping the accounting tag in a way that excludes promos, and 2) adjust the runtime fallback policy so it prefers Dedicated burst within the same org/tag instead of spilling to PAYG in a different chargeable account.

nina (Billing): next steps I propose:
- open cloud billing ticket requesting a credit re-allocation for INV-2026-04-01 (include usage CSV & invoice)
- create internal ledger entry to offset the cost while cloud processes the adjustment
- update credit assignment automation to include reserved-commit tag when promo pool available

Command I ran to tag the suspected lines:
```
/billing export --invoice INV-2026-04-01 --format csv > inv-INV-2026-04-01.csv
/billing assign-credit --from promo-APR2026 --to reserved-commit --amount 8102 --note "retroapply for ap-east dedicated fallback"
```

maya (Finance): these are marketing promo credits, not customer contractual credits — we can absorb the adjustment once we get confirmation. please loop in legal only if cloud disputes chargeback.

jun (Finance Ops): I’ll prepare the journal entry and hold a provisional ledger reversal. Also will ask billing to disable auto-apply for reserved-commit accounts until we fix the tagging automation. can we get an alert for future "promo pool mismatch" events?

alex (Infra): will change the fallback policy to prefer same-tag capacity and add a canary to test tomorrow 08:00 UTC. I’ll also push a guard in the deprovision pipeline to preserve billing tags.

nina (Billing): opened ticket #BILL-4832 with cloud provider (CC: finance-ops). ETA 48-72h. attaching invoice + usage CSV. I’ll post updates in this thread. :spiral_calendar: :email:

maya (Finance): thanks. please include the finance ticket id once you create the internal adjustment. tagging @jun for the journal.

billing-bot: Audit log: credit assignment attempt failed: reserved-commit policy forbids org-promo application (error code CREDIT_TAG_MISMATCH). Logged at 2026-04-02T02:14:11Z.

nina (Billing): final note — promo-APR2026 has a hard expiry (no extensions). if cloud refuses retro allocation we’ll submit an internal marketing reclaim and credit customer-facing accounts accordingly.

jun (Finance Ops): noted. I’ll follow up with ledger entry and escalation if BILL-4832 stalls.
